summary: The GLRI Act of 2026 extends the Great Lakes Restoration Initiative through fiscal year 2030 and authorizes an appropriation of $475,000,000 for each fiscal year from 2027 through 2030 to carry out programs and projects that protect and restore the Great Lakes.

affected_groups.effect: Receive continued authorization for funding up to $475,000,000 annually through fiscal year 2030.
affected_groups.group: Programs and projects related to the Great Lakes

key_provisions: Reauthorizes the Great Lakes Restoration Initiative through fiscal year 2030.
Authorizes $475,000,000 to be appropriated for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2030 to carry out the initiative's programs and projects.

summary_detail.plain_summary: The GLRI Act of 2026 extends the Great Lakes Restoration Initiative through fiscal year 2030 and authorizes an appropriation of $475,000,000 for each fiscal year from 2027 through 2030 to carry out programs and projects that protect and restore the Great Lakes.
summary_detail.significance: The bill maintains funding and authorization for ongoing environmental protection and restoration efforts in the Great Lakes region at a level of $475 million per year through 2030.
